the existing missing-price rejection is unchanged; proven by source tests over a recorded auto.dev record carrying priceUnformatted 0\u0022,\u0022VehiclePricing.LowestCurrentPrice and LowestCurrentPurchasePrice ignore any posting whose latest price observation is below that same floor, so a zero already stored on the ledger (JTDBCMFE2T3156781 from the 2026-09-26 search) cannot rank first, set a budget figure, or print as the current price in show; a vehicle whose only active posting is below the floor reports no current price, exactly as one with no active posting does; proven by tests\u0022,\u0022DiffRenderer and the diff service never list a below-floor price under New or Price drops (a posting the sources now reject never reaches the ledger, and a stored one is skipped); dotnet build and dotnet test succeed with zero warnings; commits are small with conventional messages, no em dashes, no AI attribution\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Reported by run session odonomics-59 on 2026-09-26 08:03 EDT (notes/run-session-2026-09-22.md, Gaps found; full output notes/search-2026-09-26.txt line 19): auto.dev returned priceUnformatted 0 for JTDBCMFE2T3156781, a 2026 Corolla Hybrid with 6 miles; search printed it under New as a zero price and stored a zero PriceObservation, so odo rank will place it first as the cheapest car. Code: src/Odonomics/Sources/AutoDevSource.cs line 70 reads priceUnformatted and line 91 rejects only a null price; src/Odonomics/Sources/MarketcheckSource.cs lines 74 and 96 do the same for the price field; the rejection message lands in SourceResult.Rejections (IListingSource.cs). src/Odonomics/Ledger/VehiclePricing.cs is the one place rank (RankCommand.cs line 35 and 49), budget, and show turn postings into a current price; LatestAskingPrice there is the natural place to skip a placeholder. LedgerUpsertService.cs appends a PriceObservation per changed price and needs no change. Do not add a data migration to delete the stored zero; ignoring it at read time is enough and keeps the observation as history. the source shown is the first posting the run saw; proven by a diff test where one new VIN arrives from two sources in one run and produces exactly one New row\u0022,\u0022A vehicle the ledger already knew whose first-ever posting on a source was created by this run is reported under a new SearchDiff list and heading, \\u0027Also listed at (N)\\u0027, one row per VIN naming every source it gained this run (for example \\u0027auto.dev, marketcheck\\u0027) with the year, make, model, and current price; that heading replaces the current behavior of filing such sightings under New; proven by a diff test that seeds a VIN through one source in an earlier run and sees it gain two sources in the current run, producing zero New rows and one Also-listed row\u0022,\u0022Moved, Price drops, and Gone are unchanged, the end-of-run counters and the walk summary that print New use the new definition, and DiffRenderer prints the new section after New and before Moved, omitting it when empty; the walk\\u0027s own tests over the recorded fixtures still pass; the README\\u0027s search and walk sections describe the four headings; dotnet build and dotnet test succeed with zero warnings; commits are small with conventional messages, no em dashes, no AI attribution\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Reported by run session odonomics-59 on 2026-09-26 08:03 EDT (notes/run-session-2026-09-22.md, Gaps found; full output notes/search-2026-09-26.txt): New (37) held 36 distinct VINs, 15 of which were already on the ledger from walk run 4 on 09-24/25 (the VIN list is in the gap entry), and JTDKAMFU9M3144688 appeared twice because auto.dev and marketcheck both returned it. Root cause is deliberate code, not an accident: src/Odonomics/Ledger/LedgerDiffService.cs, in ComputeAsync, has a branch (the comment beginning \\u0027First time this already-known VIN has ever been seen on this source\\u0027) that adds a known VIN to newEntries deduped by (VIN, source), which is why a known VIN can print twice; the genuinely-new branch above it dedups by VIN. The class remarks describe that choice and should be rewritten to describe the new split. SearchDiff is the record at the top of the same file; DiffRenderer.cs in src/Odonomics/Cli renders it for both search (SearchCommand.cs) and walk (WalkCommand.cs), so the change lands in both commands by construction. Keep the stale-posting lookup (moved and price-drop detection for known VINs) exactly as it is. Existing diff tests are under tests/Odonomics.Tests/Ledger.
